invariants.name: monotonicity
invariants.description: BFS distance never decreases and rp propagation only occurs along increasing distances, preventing cycles and ensuring the process conforms to hypercube layers.

invariants.name: bit_accumulation
invariants.description: The rp value for each vertex is built by collecting distinct dimension bits along a shortest path from the root using bitwise OR, which equals XOR because no dimension repeats on a shortest path in a hypercube.

invariants.name: distance_popcount_equality
invariants.description: The BFS distance from the root equals the number of 1-bits in the rp identifier for every vertex.

properties.increment_property: each forward step adds exactly one new set bit

invariants.name: bijective_mapping
invariants.description: After the BFS traversal, rp[0..2^n-1] is a permutation of {0,...,2^n-1}, providing an inverse mapping that reconstructs the simple hypercube labeling.

invariants.name: coloring_feasibility
invariants.description: A vertex coloring satisfying the condition that every vertex has neighbors of all n colors exists if and only if n is a power of two.

properties.n_condition: n is a power of two

invariants.name: coloring_xor_assignment
invariants.description: When a valid coloring exists, the color of the vertex with simple label i is the XOR of the indices of the set bits of i, which ensures the adjacency color property.
